mechanism.notes: J1 replaced by a spherical four-bar (all axes through GH) whose coupler is link 1 and turns about a virtual pole. bodies: crank A, crank B, coupler = link 1 (carries J2), link 2, arm-end (hub-3 plate + neck). joints: base pins A0 (ACTIVE, the J1 drive) and B0, coupler pins A1, B1 (PASSIVE), J2, J3 O20 hubs; 1 loop (the four-bar). Passives set by the crank angle (loop mobility 1): not sensed. Default slim = 0 (every pin an O20 hub; slim = 1 makes the 3 passive pins MR63ZZ pairs). custom: base, 2 cranks, link 1, link 2, neck, 6 hub shafts (est.); catalogue: 6 x MR117 pair (est.).
